notes: Employer ATS integrations plus manually verified official careers listings. Public aggregator feeds are supplementary and not exhaustive. Curated entries are reviewed during live searches; recheck employer page before applying.

curated.title: L2 Technical Support Lead – SIP and VoIP
curated.description: Hands-on technical leadership for L2 support across contact centre and voice services. Own escalated tickets, troubleshoot SIP routing, APIs, integrations, cloud infrastructure and Cisco voice/contact-centre technologies. Guide L2 engineers, manage ticket and SLA discipline, coordinate with customers, Engineering and Product. AWS fundamentals and enterprise escalation ownership preferred. Remote role based in India; occasional Chennai travel may be required.

curated.title: Technical Support Engineer - L2
curated.description: Remote L2 technical support for voice and conversational AI systems. Own complex customer escalations, investigate voice integrations, REST APIs and webhooks, debug logs and call recordings, lead incident response and write post-mortems. Requires 5+ years technical or implementation support in B2B SaaS, API/webhook debugging, SQL and familiarity with SIP and IVR routing.

curated.title: Technical Project Manager – Contact Center & Voice Bot Delivery
curated.description: Own end-to-end delivery of enterprise Voicebot and Contact Centre projects from kickoff through integrations, UAT, go-live and hypercare. Customer-facing project governance, stakeholder coordination, SIP knowledge, telephony readiness, APIs, webhooks, CRM and contact-centre integrations. Requires 5–8 years project/program management delivering customer-facing technical systems; SIP is mandatory. This is delivery leadership, not an engineering-manager role.

curated.title: Senior Implementation Consultant, CCAAS
curated.description: Manage end-to-end implementation of Sprinklr CCaaS solutions for enterprise clients. Define implementation strategy and solution architecture; mentor junior consultants; lead discovery and requirements workshops; own customer engagements; coordinate Product, Engineering and Customer Success; conduct health checks and remediation plans. Requires 3+ years deploying voice and non-voice contact-centre applications such as Genesys Engage, Amazon Connect, Cisco Webex Contact Center, RingCentral or similar; complex CCaaS/UCaaS/CPaaS implementation leadership; strong TCP/IP, VoIP, SIP, RTP, WebRTC, ACD, IVR, CTI, dialer, SBC; API integration and troubleshooting.

curated.title: Sr. Manager - Implementation (CCAAS)
curated.description: Lead a team of implementation consultants and oversee concurrent enterprise software deployments, client delivery, implementation strategy, quality, KPIs and process improvements. Requires 8+ years enterprise software implementation and 5+ years deploying voice/chat/email contact-centre applications such as Genesys Engage, Amazon Connect, Cisco Webex Contact Center, RingCentral or similar. CCaaS/UCaaS/CPaaS experience, team leadership and customer-facing delivery required. Voice protocols and contact-centre infrastructure are advantageous.

curated.title: Technical Account Manager -3 (Solution Architecture/Solution Consultant)
curated.description: Customer-facing Technical Account Manager for strategic domestic enterprise customers. Own technical account engagement, adoption and retention; lead discovery, solution design and architecture discussions; advise on APIs, integrations, call flows and automation; conduct customer workshops and solution reviews; manage escalations and coordinate with Product, Engineering, Network, Sales and Support. Requires 4–8 years in TAM, Solutions Engineering, Solution Consulting or Customer Success Engineering, enterprise domestic account management, technical solutioning and executive stakeholder exposure. CPaaS, CCaaS, Conversational AI and Contact Centre experience preferred.
